_comment: P2-1j. Every screen delta scripts/menus/audit_mn_screen_coverage.py finds
and this project has DECIDED about. Nothing here is silent: an entry must
name the ruling that accepted it, and an entry whose delta no longer
exists fails the run, so a fixed element cannot keep its excuse.
status 'ruled'  a decision exists -- a board row, a plan phase, or a fact
read out of the source itself.
status 'open'   the delta is real and nobody has ruled on it yet. These
are the OWNER'S QUEUE: the audit prints them as [OPEN] and
counts them separately from the ruled ones, and P2-1j's
report packet lists every one. They are allowed to pass
the gate only so the gate can be RED for something new.
A key spelled 're:<pattern>' matches by regex, which is how one decision
stays one entry: 'the ten fighters P2-3 has not produced' is a single
ruling, and ten copies of it would be ten places for it to rot.
kind 'nodraw' belongs to the IMPORTED 1P/modes screens, which run the
original scene source and draw through the reloc path rather than the
baked UI kit. It means: the sprite's o2r container is staged in NitroFS,
the port resolves the symbol, and there is still no Sprite geometry row
in sNdsBattleInterfaceSpriteDescs -- so the blanket u32 endian pass
leaves the header swapped and nothing is painted. The art is present and
invisible; the fix is a geometry row, never an asset.

entries.reason: The emblem's own animation cels, and P2-1k (d) re-read who draws them: they are dMNTitleLogoAnimSprites, referenced ONLY inside mnTitleMakeLogo's opening-cinematic arm (mntitle.c:1096-1155, gated on scene_prev == nSCKindOpeningNewcomers). This shell always takes mnTitleMakeLogoNoOpening (:1051), which builds the resting FULL sprite alone -- the one this bake ships. They are therefore the INTRO's cels, not the label animation's: P2-1k (d) built the label pop (mnTitleMakeLabels' five animated pieces) from a baked pose table and it needs none of them.
entries.ruling: PROJECT_GOAL.md Current Milestone step 7 -- the intro cinematic is deferred by owner decision, and these cels arrive with it; re-read and re-ruled by P2-1k (d), which landed the label animation these were previously attributed to

entries.reason: THE PREVIEW PANEL'S PER-STAGE ART, and the source draws it -- this audit's lexical rule simply cannot see it. mnMapsMakePreviewWallpaper (:956) draws sMNMapsGroundInfo->wallpaper, a POINTER FIELD of the MPGroundData at llGRPupupuMapMapHeader (mptypes.h:182), not a '&ll<Name>Sprite' reference in any mn* source. entries.reason: The AUTO subtitle glyph is the sp1C table entry of mnVSOptionsMakeSubtitle (mnvsoptions.c:744-749), which is unconditional DATA; its only draw readers are the handicap-Auto arm at :788-793 and the team/stage arms at :808-838, all inside the #if defined(REGION_JP) subtitle block (:753-864). entries.reason: The 22 subtitle sprites are the offsets1/offsets2 tables of mnItemSwitchMakeSubtitle (mnvsitemswitch.c:255-289), which are unconditional DATA; their only reader is the draw arm at :296-345, which is entirely inside #if defined(REGION_JP). A 2026-09-04 audit commit (2ddb47b4edf) called them live in the US build after misreading the guard; this entry is the correction.

entries.reason: mnCharactersUpdateMotionName draws these input/name captions only while the source showcase fighter is executing one of its three special-move motion kinds. The native Character Data screen currently reuses the native CSS selected-pose fighter owner, so those special states are not executed and showing a caption would claim a move the on-screen fighter is not performing. All unconditional Character Data art is baked and drawn.
entries.ruling: P2-7 Character Data time-box, 2026-09-12: this is explicit dynamic-showcase debt, not a visual acceptance. Remove it when the native Character Data preview owns the source random-motion state machine and can bind captions to the actual displayed special motion.
